tips.text: Research Akstiletto first; Baza stays locked until it is done, and you never need to build it.
Expect an easy weapon; the only wait is the two research timers.
Start both research timers as soon as their resources are in, then farm while the 72 hours tick.
Do not spend the Alloy Plate you need for the build on research first; research takes 1,500 and the build takes 4,300.
Research in a small Ghost-tier clan; bigger tiers multiply the resource cost.
